title: feat(fields): record forms use the platform date picker for date fields (objectui#12622)
body:
Fixes #12622
Clause-②: no

## What changes

A record form's `date` and `datetime` fields now draw the platform date picker instead of the browser's native `input type=date` / `datetime-local`. The picker is a text box in the display locale's format (`10/16/2026` in `en`, `2026/10/16` in `zh`). It has a calendar popover (the same `Calendar` primitive the calendar view's date popover opens, localized by the same date-fns resolver), keyboard entry (blur or Enter commits), a clear button, and Today / Tomorrow shortcuts.

- `packages/fields/src/widgets/DatePickerField.tsx`: `DatePickerField` / `DateTimePickerField`, one shared control. The read-only face is `DateField` / `DateTimeField`'s own, rendered unchanged. A stored nonexistent day keeps the existing `fields.date.impossibleDay` / `fields.dateTime.impossibleDay` notice.
- `packages/fields/src/widgets/localeDateText.ts`: formats and reads the text with `Intl` in the display locale (Latin digits). It accepts the locale's digit order, an ISO day in any locale, a two-digit year, and for `datetime` a 24-hour or AM/PM clock (or the locale's own afternoon marker).
- `packages/fields/src/index.tsx`: `FORM_FACE_LOADERS`. Only `registerField` (what a form resolves `field:date` / `field:datetime` to) takes the picker.
- Five new language-pack keys in all ten packs plus the provider-less `FIELD_DEFAULTS`: `fields.datePicker.today`, `tomorrow`, `clear`, `openCalendar`, `invalid`.

## The value written is unchanged

Both faces go through the existing native adapters (`toDateInputValue`, `toDateTimeInputValue`, `fromDateTimeInputValue`). A `date` field writes `YYYY-MM-DD`, a `datetime` field writes an ISO instant, and clear writes `''`, all as the native inputs did. Typed text that names no real date is not written. The box is marked `aria-invalid` and a notice names the expected pattern.

## Where the native input stays (measured)

- A form whose `field:date` widget is not registered (no `@object-ui/fields` loaded) falls back to the form renderer's own input, with the `inputType` that `ObjectForm` maps.
- The inline editors import `DateField` / `DateTimeField` directly and are unchanged: `FieldEditWidget` (grid / detail inline editors, the kanban required-fields dialog) and plugin-detail's `InlineFieldInput`.
- `getLazyFieldWidget` (the action-param and bulk-action dialogs) shares `fieldWidgetMap` and is unchanged. Moving these surfaces too would break pins in `app-shell` / `plugin-grid` / `plugin-detail` / `plugin-kanban`, which are outside this card's file surface. That follow-up is recorded in the report as a decision for the seat.

## Measured against the dispatch's mechanism assumptions

- **A1 (existing picker has locale, clear, keyboard entry): partly false.** The list filters (`FilterBuilder`, `UserFilters`, `FilterUI`) use no picker at all: they render a native `input type=date`. The calendar view opens `Popover` + `Calendar` inline. The exported `DatePicker` in `@object-ui/components` has no consumer in the repo. It is a button trigger with the date in the locale (`PPP`) and a calendar, with no text entry, no clear and no shortcuts. So the reuse is the `Calendar` primitive and its one locale resolver. No second calendar was written, and the text box, clear and shortcut layer is the new part. Its labels are the five keys above.
- **A2 (readonly / required / min / max parity):** the native input received only what `toDomProps` forwards: `id`, `name`, `autoFocus`, `tabIndex`, `onBlur` / `onFocus` / `onClick`, `className`, `disabled`, plus `aria-*` / `data-*`. `ObjectForm` maps no `min` / `max` for date fields, so the native input honoured none. The text box receives the same set, so `aria-required`, `disabled` and the host `id` carry over (pinned). `readonly` renders the unchanged read-only face.

## Tests (at `10527ec3e`)

- `packages/fields/src/widgets/localeDateText.test.ts` (9): en and zh format and placeholder, typed-text reading, a round-trip in all ten locales.
- `packages/fields/src/widgets/DatePickerField-12622.test.tsx` (13): no `input[type=date]`, en and zh rendering, typing writes the ISO day, Enter commits, a bad day is not written, a calendar pick writes ISO, Today / Tomorrow, clear, host id / `aria-required` / disabled, the read-only face, and `datetime` writes an ISO instant and keeps its time on a calendar pick.
- `packages/plugin-form/src/__tests__/recordFormDatePicker-12622.test.tsx` (2): through the real `ObjectForm` and `registerAllFields`, the date rows carry the picker and the label still names the text box. Submitting writes `2026-10-20` and the ISO instant. CONTROL: the `text` and `number` rows still render `input type=text` / `type=number`.
- Ablation: `node ../objectstack/scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` replaced the `FORM_FACE_LOADERS[...] ?? loader` read in `registerField` with plain `loader`. The anchor went 1 to 0 and the blob changed. The form-path pin turned red (`Tests 2 failed (2)`, "date picker not rendered"). Restore: blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty. A first attempt used a replacement the tool refused (its text was a substring of the anchor), so no test ran in that attempt.
- Type-check (closure built first): `@object-ui/fields`, `@object-ui/plugin-form`, `@object-ui/i18n` `type-check` exit 0. The new test files are confirmed in `tsconfig.test.json` via `--listFiles`.
- Targeted vitest: 31 files, 931 tests passed. These are every fields test that touches `registerField` / `registerAllFields` / `getLazyFieldWidget` / the labelling table, plus `datetime-widgets`, `date-locale-channel`, `inline-widget-aria-invalid-7126`, and the i18n `all-locales-key-parity`, `en-zh-key-parity`, `fallback-placeholder-spelling-3512`.
- **NOT MEASURED: whole-package runs of `packages/fields/`, `packages/plugin-form/`, `packages/i18n/`.** Reason: the shared verify lock was held by another seat's run for more than 25 minutes, so it was never acquired. The narrowed targeted run above is declared in its place, and CI runs the full set.
- Gates, each exit 0: `check:phantom-deps`, `check:self-import`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:doc-example-readers`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:side-effects-array`, `check:element-data-source-declaration`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:action-forward-parity`, `check:designer-field-key-parity`, `check:icon-record-names`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-designer-parity`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:i18n-dead-keys` (no new key reported), `check-hand-rolled-comment-mask.mjs`, `check-changeset-fixed.mjs`, `check-changeset-presence.mjs`.
- Lint, narrowed: `eslint --no-inline-config` with the root `eslint.config.js` (the config every package's `eslint .` resolves) over the 17 changed `.ts` / `.tsx` files gives 0 errors. Only pre-existing warnings remain in `index.tsx`, plus three `as any` test-fixture warnings. Type-aware linting is not enabled (no `parserOptions.project` / `projectService`), so this diff cannot move a verdict in an untouched file.

## Acceptance notes

- Screenshots of Create Opportunity at 1280 px, light and dark, are the maintainer's browser check, as the dispatch states.
- `datetime`: the time is set by typing (or kept from the value on a calendar pick). The popover has no time control.
